Measured: Emulated S9+ landscape (846 x 411/340/300), hatchback, manual, stalled: one finger on Restart was refused with a keyboard hint ('clutch down (z) or neutral to start'); with the clutch held at 1.00, the tap on Restart fired 0 click events, so no restart. After the fix: one finger gets 'Hold the clutch, then tap Restart'; clutch held restarts at 586-780 rpm at all three heights. Checked on the live site after #88 merged (846 x 340/300, Mac font and Verdana): restarts at 564-594 rpm.
Cause: Restart was a click-only button, and a tap made while another finger is down fires no click; the loop's hints name keys (written for play.py's terminal).

Measured: At 846 x 300 (a landscape phone with Chrome's toolbar showing) the middle column ran 41 px past the dials' row and the clutchless-shift hint printed over the trip computer (screenshot); at 846 x 411 it just fitted. After the fix: the hint is an overlay toast, and the dials' row can't shrink below its content (the strip scrolls instead). At 846 x 300 with text at 125%, every layout rule holds (column inside the dials' row, strip below, hint above the strip, lamps below the top bar), with the Mac font and with Verdana, and on the live site after #88 merged. (A first fix leaned on the Mac's font; CI's Linux font broke it.)
Cause: The hint was a line in the middle column, and the dials' row could shrink below its content (min-height: 0), so on a short screen the column spilled into the strip.

Dev server, full size, 6 workers. Stop at 367 s: still building 30 s later; fixed, Stop at 205 s mid-row now answers in 0.5 s and the workers end 2 s later. ETA: 258 min at the first piece of a ~19 min build; fixed: over a whole production build (27.5 min), 0.63x of the real time left at the first piece, then 0.84-0.98x from the 5th piece on. Not reproduced: stuck at 0 (the first piece came at 156 s).
Cause: Stop was checked only between pieces, and a running Python piece can't be interrupted (no SharedArrayBuffer, ADR-003). The ETA counted a row (~4 cells) as one piece and ignored the parallel workers.
Status: Stop and ETA fixed on live site; stuck at 0 not reproduced

Measured: Emulated S9+ landscape (846 x 411/340/300), Manual: the brake sat on the left beside the clutch, 722-723 px from a right thumb resting on the throttle. Every pedal is ~68 px wide (the old brake/clutch width; the throttle was 144), so the dash keeps its width (518 -> 525 px) and overflows 0/0/8 px at the three heights, against 0/1/24 before. e2e:enjoy checks the sides at all three heights with 125% text; its mutants are caught. Not yet tried on the owner's phone.
Cause: The page put the brake with the clutch on the left (one pedal per thumb in Auto), not where a driver's right foot finds it.

After the fix: + over − in a column between the dash and the brake, low, 150-169 px from a right thumb resting on the throttle; the left thumb keeps the clutch. e2e:enjoy: with the clutch held on the left, the right-hand paddles go N -> 1 -> 2 -> 1; a − wired to shift up is caught. On the live site after #120 merged (2026-10-11): the deployed bundle carries the new layout (the paddles' column, the pedal name's 16cqi fit, the new start hint); main's CI ran e2e:enjoy 25 of 25. Not yet tried on the owner's phone.
Cause: The − paddle was placed on the left, mirroring + on the right, over the clutch.

Measured: Live loop + streaming synth coupled as the app couples them (60 Hz loop, sources blended every 17 quanta), warm, standard air; six cases (crdi15 exterior: Auto in 4th at 60%, neutral at full pedal, Auto on the brake; crdi15 cabin with a 1 s lift; hatch15 cabin; the single in neutral). Against a zero-lag reference (each shape tracker replaced by a centred 0.2 s average of its own input), 100 ms windows: main +3.2 to +9.0 dB on the tip-in, -3.9 to -10.4 dB on the lift-off. The same before P09 (not a regression; there since Phase 4). After the fix: +0.8 to +3.5 dB, -0.2 to -0.7 dB; the steady sound within 0.12 dB over 30 cases. tools/b08_tip_in.py; A/B WAVs for the owner in out/b08.
Cause: Each source's shape tracker (a one-pole over 0.3 s) lagged a step in the source's level while the level law applied the step again: the step came through twice for ~0.3 s.
Status: Fix in PR #141 (draft), waiting for the owner's listen

Measured: Headless Chrome on the built app, /enjoy. Start, drive, Stop, 40 times: the sound outlived Stop in 1 of 40, and in 2 of 40 at a 4x CPU throttle (a phone), still playing 6 s later at rms ~0.027 (an idle's level), until the next Start. A gearbox tapped while Starting…: 6 of 6 left the page on Starting… for good at 4x (only a reload recovered); unthrottled, 1 of 6 drove anyway, in Auto with Manual shown. A double tap on the first Start: 0 of 16, not fixed. After the fix: e2e:enjoy forces each race (worker terminate held back 150 ms; the grid's fetch or the worker's ready held 1.5 s): 36 passed; mutants 6 of 6 caught. Not yet tried on the owner's phone.
Cause: The sound worklet plays its last frame until a reset; Stop's reset and the loop's frames travel on different channels, unordered, so a frame the stopping worker posted after the reset set the sound again. And Stop did nothing to a load in progress: it went on and drove, or sat on Starting… once its worker was gone.
